declare @$lockedDate nvarchar(512), @$d smalldatetime select @$d = dateadd(m, 1, cast(str(@y, 4) + replace(str(@p1, 2), ' ', '0') + '01' as smalldatetime)) - 1 select @$lockedDate = case when @@language = 'v' then N'Đã khóa số liệu, kiểm tra lại ngày giới hạn hoặc ngày khóa sổ.' else N'Data is locked, you must modify system locked date.' end if exists(select 1 from dmstt where ngay_ks >= @$d) begin select 'ky' as field, @$lockedDate as message return end if exists (select 1 from options where name = 'm_hs_pb_unit' and val = '1') begin if @u <> '' begin if exists(select 1 from dmdvcsks where charindex(',' + rtrim(ma_dvcs) + ',', ',' + replace(@u, ' ', '') + ',') > 0 and ngay_ks >= @$d) begin select 'ky' as field, @$lockedDate as message return end end else begin if exists(select 1 from dmdvcsks where ma_dvcs in (select ma_dvcs from sysunitrights where user_id = @@userID) and ngay_ks >= @$d) begin select 'ky' as field, @$lockedDate as message return end end end
select nam, stt_rec into #$dmpbn from dmpbn where nam = @y and exists(select 1 from @s where patindex('%,' + rtrim(stt_rec) + ',%', text) > 0) exec rs_CalcAllocTrans @p1, @p2, @y, 1, @u, @@userID, @@admin -- loai_hs = 9 exec rs_CreateAllocTrans @p1, @p2, @y, @@userID, @u, @@admin, 1 drop table #$dmpbn select '' as value return

declare @$lockedDate nvarchar(512), @$d smalldatetime select @$d = dateadd(m, 1, cast(str(@y, 4) + replace(str(@p1, 2), ' ', '0') + '01' as smalldatetime)) - 1 select @$lockedDate = case when @@language = 'v' then N'Đã khóa số liệu, kiểm tra lại ngày giới hạn hoặc ngày khóa sổ.' else N'Data is locked, you must modify system locked date.' end if exists(select 1 from dmstt where ngay_ks >= @$d) begin select 'ky' as field, @$lockedDate as message return end if exists (select 1 from options where name = 'm_hs_pb_unit' and val = '1') begin if @u <> '' begin if exists(select 1 from dmdvcsks where charindex(',' + rtrim(ma_dvcs) + ',', ',' + replace(@u, ' ', '') + ',') > 0 and ngay_ks >= @$d) begin select 'ky' as field, @$lockedDate as message return end end else begin if exists(select 1 from dmdvcsks where ma_dvcs in (select ma_dvcs from sysunitrights where user_id = @@userID) and ngay_ks >= @$d) begin select 'ky' as field, @$lockedDate as message return end end end
declare @baseCurrency char(3) select @baseCurrency = val from options where name = 'm_ma_nt0'
select nam, stt_rec into #$dmpbn from dmpbn where nam = @y and exists(select 1 from @s where patindex('%,' + rtrim(stt_rec) + ',%', text) > 0) update a set user_id0 = @@userID, user_id2 = @@userID from dmpbn a join #$dmpbn b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where a.nam = @y update a set tien_nt = 0, ma_nt = '' from dmpbn a join #$dmpbn b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where a.ma_nt = rtrim(@baseCurrency) and a.nam = @y exec rs_CreateAllocTrans @p1, @p2, @y, @@userID, @u, @@admin drop table #$dmpbn select '' as value return

declare @$lockedDate nvarchar(512), @$d smalldatetime select @$d = dateadd(m, 1, cast(str(@y, 4) + replace(str(@p1, 2), ' ', '0') + '01' as smalldatetime)) - 1 select @$lockedDate = case when @@language = 'v' then N'Đã khóa số liệu, kiểm tra lại ngày giới hạn hoặc ngày khóa sổ.' else N'Data is locked, you must modify system locked date.' end if exists(select 1 from dmstt where ngay_ks >= @$d) begin select 'ky' as field, @$lockedDate as message return end if exists (select 1 from options where name = 'm_hs_pb_unit' and val = 1) begin if @u <> '' begin if exists(select 1 from dmdvcsks where charindex(',' + rtrim(ma_dvcs) + ',', ',' + replace(@u, ' ', '') + ',') > 0 and ngay_ks >= @$d) begin select 'ky' as field, @$lockedDate as message return end end else begin if exists(select 1 from dmdvcsks where ma_dvcs in (select ma_dvcs from sysunitrights where user_id = @@userID) and ngay_ks >= @$d) begin select 'ky' as field, @$lockedDate as message return end end end select nam, stt_rec into #$dmpbn from dmpbn where nam = @y and exists(select 1 from @s where patindex('%,' + rtrim(stt_rec) + ',%', text) > 0) exec rs_DeleteAllocTrans @p1, @p2, @y, @@userID, @@admin, @u, 'Del' drop table #$dmpbn select '' as value return

declare @q nvarchar(max), @slstt_rec nvarchar(max) select @slstt_rec = text from @lstt_rec
select top 0 @slstt_rec as data, b.line_nbr, c.stt_rec, c.loai_hs, b.ps_no as hs9tien into #m from wrkgl b right join (select null as v) x on 1 = 0, dmpb c right join (select null as v) x1 on 1 = 0
insert into #m(data) select data from [dbo].[FastBusiness$Function$System$Split](@slstt_rec, char(252)) a where id > 1
update #m set line_nbr = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(data, 1, char(253)), stt_rec = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(data, 2, char(253))
update #m set hs9tien = 0 update #m set loai_hs = b.loai_hs from #m a join dmpb b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec set @q = 'update #m set hs9tien = b.hs9tien' + replace(str(@p2, 2), ' ', '0') + ' from #m a join dmpb1n$hs9 b on b.nam = ' + ltrim(@y) + ' and a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where a.loai_hs = ''9'';' exec (@q)
select '' as array$, hs9tien from #m a order by line_nbr return
